Field notes

Map and marker precision

The terrain is the unmodified original Wiki image, with its exact aspect ratio. Compound pins are approximate area anchors. Wiki key diagrams retain their floor labels and indoor photos. A surface projection does not establish a surveyed indoor coordinate.

Reference & dates

The Wiki calls Gravity_Defier’s image a “16k orthographic map”; the published PNG actually contains 7,187 × 7,382 pixels. This atlas preserves that file without tracing, recolouring or downsampling. The image is dated January 2025 and may predate current game changes. The 1:1 button shows one original image pixel per CSS pixel.

Conflicting key timing

The Locked Room overview says a spawn stays fixed until rejoining and keys respawn from midnight until the door is unlocked. The Ronograd City and Naval Base pages describe changes with the day/night cycle. No reliable respawn timer is provided here.

Fort Ronograd

The Wiki reports an empty locked room with no obtainable room key. The Rusted Key opens the Fort’s sewer entrance; it is separate from the five loot-room keys.

Other Wiki notes

Keys appear when a player is nearby. An unlocked door stays open. The overview says room loot requires a map reset or leaving and rejoining to refresh; this has not been tested in game.
